_readme: Behind the gate, and what the gate was barred against.
An interior wall runs down column 4 from row 1 to row 4, so the only way east is the
gap on row 5 - and the Keeper stands in it. Same rule as the hollow: unavoidable by
geometry, visible from the doorway, and gone the moment it is beaten, which is also how
The lantern is where it always was in spirit - the far corner, on a bush - and still
sets the flag the warden's hook reads. What changed is that the room now says why
